The pinned source explicitly states that Proposition prop_P does not generalize to the epsilon-Banach or epsilon-C* setting (approximate_algebras.tex:629). Moreover Co_Q is constructed by applying theta to the bounded operator L_Q R_Q+R_Q L_Q-1 in the associative operator algebra (tex:1054-1064), not by applying theta directly to Q. Thus tilde Q=Co_Q(Q) does not make this direct application valid; proving ||Co_Q(Q)-Q||=O(e) requires the separate compression-map approximation plus delta-projection estimates, neither supplied by this node's registered theta input. The claimed inference therefore has a genuine gap and conflates two distinct theta constructions.
